_comment: Passive animals (ADR 0022). Distances and speeds in metres (Minecraft blocks are 1 m, so its values carry over), times in seconds, health in half-hearts. food = items that tempt (the mob follows a player holding one), breed adults and grow babies; drops = death drop list like mining.json (adults only, as in Minecraft); shear = what shears give (sheep), the wool grows back when it grazes. biomes = where herds spawn when the land first comes near a player; weight = Minecraft's spawn weight among the species of a biome; group = herd size.
